what_happened.line: The Select Board heard the town manager's preliminary FY22 budget; no budget vote was taken at this meeting.
The board approved a common victualler license for Voyage Nutrition at 5 Summer Street #10, 4-0 by roll call.
The board approved the third quarter water commitment, with four ayes; the vote on the vice chair signing warrants was not audible.
Free cash is proposed for capital, OPEB and stabilization, not the operating budget; the town manager also proposed a health insurance stabilization fund.
Greenleaf agreed to a second outreach meeting, possibly March 10; the vice chair will ask the chair to schedule the host agreement afterward.

why_it_matters: The preliminary FY22 budget sets the starting point for next year's tax levy, school and Monty Tech assessments, and capital spending that residents will vote on at Town Meeting.
Using free cash for capital and reserves rather than operations, and a possible health insurance stabilization fund, bear on whether costs return to the tax bill in FY23.
watch_next: February 16 appointments workshop; later meetings set for March 2, 9, 16 and 23.
Greenleaf second community outreach meeting, potentially March 10 at 7 pm, then a host agreement agenda item.
